Title: Early drug intervention can be helpful in reverting paralysis due to stroke
NewsSummary: Stroke is a commonly encountered neurological disorder leading to disability and mortality," revealed by Dr Shahid Masud Baig, Associate Professor of Medicine, Consultant Neurologist and Acting Head of Neurology at the Aga Khan University Hospital.

content.text: Stroke is a commonly encountered neurological disorder leading to disability and mortality," revealed by Dr Shahid Masud Baig, Associate Professor of Medicine, Consultant Neurologist and Acting Head of Neurology at the Aga Khan University Hospital (AKUH). He was giving a presentation on "Stroke" at Signs. Symptoms and Care' monthly health awareness programme held on August 26, 2000.

Dr Shahid baig disclosed that"Stoke is a brain disorder that occurs when blood supply to any part of brain is compromised and as a result loss of brain function occurs. Stroke is the third leading cause of death in develop countries In US for example. a stroke affects 4 out of 1,000 people."

Dr Shahid baig further added."The incidence of stroke rises dramatically with advancing age and the risk of stroke almost double with each decade after age of 35 years, In Pakistan, the frequency of stroke is about the same, though definite data is not available. Therefore, it is important to know what causes stroke how can we prevent it."

A stroke may be caused by reduced blood flow that results in deficient blood supply and death of tissues ill the brain. Causes of ischemic stroke are blood clots that form in the brain, or pieces of other atherosclerotic plaque from vessel or via the clot that travel to the brain from other locations. Brain Hemorrhage can also cause symptoms similar to ischemic stroke, explained Dr Shahid Baig.

Dr Shahid Baig emphasized the importance and prevention of risk factors for stroke and said,"optimal control of high blood pressure, high cholesterol, cigarette smoking, diabetes, and heart diseases could significant reduce the onset of stroke."

"Early admission and treatment in the hospital may prevent from progression or reversal of paralysis due to stroke Dr Shahid Baig."He further elaborated on commonly encountered signs and symptoms due tu stroke. Dr Shahid Baig concluded by explaining the pivotal role of rehabilitation of patients with stroke and the efficacy of new medications in the prevention of stroke. Some new drugs could even revert the paralysis due to stroke provided the patient is given medicine within three hours of onset of symptoms.
At the end of the program the panelists. which included Dr Nadir Ali Syed, Dr Mohammad Wasay and Dr Saad Shafqat explanation to the queries of the audience.
